name: Sheraton Puerto Rico Resort & Casino
positioning: A city resort in San Juan's Convention District with a rooftop infinity pool over San Juan Bay, a 24/7 casino and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a rooftop pool, bay-view rooms and a casino in central San Juan
Guests attending events at the Convention Center or Distrito T-Mobile

facts.text: The hotel is in San Juan's Convention District, steps from Distrito T-Mobile and the Convention Center.
From the rooftop infinity pool there are open views of the bay, the Convention District and Distrito T-Mobile.
Private cabanas can be reserved on the sundeck for a shaded poolside day.
The pool area includes a children's pool.
The one-bedroom Bayview Suites have a separate parlor and a private balcony overlooking San Juan Bay.
Daily yoga classes are held at the Bella Vista Terrace on the 4th floor.
The hotel offers daily salsa classes.
The Bay Rooftop Bar serves Italian-American dishes on the rooftop with views of San Juan sunsets.
Mutuo Sabor Nikkei serves Japanese-Peruvian cuisine.
The hotel is close to the major cruise terminals and Luis Munoz Marin International Airport.
The hotel is LEED New Construction certified.

highlights.text: The rooftop infinity pool has panoramic views of San Juan Bay.
Deluxe Rooms have a private balcony with a view of San Juan Bay.
The two-bedroom Presidential Suite has generous living and dining areas and a private terrace with bay views.
Zen Spa Retreat offers treatments designed to relax the body and clear the mind.

considerations.text: Escambron Beach is one mile from the resort.
The hotel sells a Day Pass to its rooftop pool deck.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort property where common areas can get crowded.
